scope: Content-addressed projection of one constrained machine principal, one verified machine identity credential, one policy-derived machine discovery snapshot, and one exact capability-registry state.
core_invariant: An Agent Passport describes an authority ceiling and requestability evidence but is never a bearer token, grant, delegation, approval, execution admission, reputation authority, or proof of global currentness.

risks: valid identity credential paired with a broader principal
attacker inserts an action and recomputes discovery digest
controls: discovery digest is not trusted as authority
requestability independently reconstructed from policy plus principal

risks: weaker policy presented with old passport
different capability registry presented as equivalent
controls: verification requires supplied evidence to reproduce the manifest
live effect path must re-evaluate current policy

risks: passport cached as a reusable grant
protocol adapter treats passport as authorization

controls: machine-principal v1 delegation remains false/depth zero
A3 requires a separately signed attenuation proof

risks: authentic old passport used after identity revocation
capability status changed after passport creation
controls: future effect admission must consult current revocation/policy evidence
required assurance recovered from PolicyEngine evaluation
confirmation and independent-approval floors copied from validated policy

risks: MCP/A2A/vendor adapter treats discovery or passport as a grant
remote completion treated as trusted authority
controls: no adapter or remote effect path in A2

next_gates: A3 separately signed attenuation-only delegation with exact subset proof
A4 signed handoff envelope bound to an exact authority/delegation head
A5 portable work receipt bound to actual effect evidence
A6 descendant-aware revocation/currentness at effect admission
